name: subagent-statusline
description: Runs a subagentStatusLine-style command and draws its output as the subagent rows under the prompt

command.title: Command
command.description: Shell command run with native-322 subagentStatusLine JSON on stdin; prints one {"id","content"} JSON line per row. Managed hook policy takes precedence. Empty: use the user's legacy subagentStatusLine.command.

refreshMs.title: Refresh interval (ms)
refreshMs.description: How often the command runs while eligible agent rows exist, including retained completed rows. Native default: 5000 ms; minimum: 1000 ms.
